# Lilla Csanaky

> Forward Deployed Engineer and Customer Solutions Engineer based in Switzerland, relocating to Berlin. Bridges customers, engineering, and product in SaaS and AI-first environments through integrations, automation, and technical delivery.

## About

Lilla Csanaky is a customer-facing engineer with 10+ years of experience across regulated industries and SaaS. She builds integrations, automates workflows, and ships scalable technical solutions end-to-end. She moves fast, adopts new tools quickly — including AI tooling — and operates at the intersection of technical implementation and customer problem-solving. She is actively seeking Forward Deployed Engineer and Solutions Engineer roles in Berlin.
